title: Stripe 2026-09-30.endive rejects payment_method_types on PaymentIntents and SetupIntents
summary: In API version 2026-09-30.endive payment_method_types is no longer writable on PaymentIntent create, update and confirm (POST /v1/payment_intents, /v1/payment_intents/{intent}, /v1/payment_intents/{intent}/confirm) or on SetupIntent create and update. Sending it returns HTTP 400 with code payment_method_types_no_longer_supported; it remains a read-only property on the objects.
migrationNote: Before upgrading to 2026-09-30.endive, remove payment_method_types from PaymentIntent and SetupIntent create, update and confirm calls (check /v1/setup_intents too). Use dynamic payment methods, optionally with excluded_payment_method_types, or pass allowed_payment_method_types, which silently filters out incompatible types instead of erroring.
